title: Row schema hash index
impact: Adds a schema-name identity fast path for schemas up to 32 columns plus private `HashMap` fallback for `RowSchema` lookup; focused `select_maps` main-isolate consumption improved 0.169 → 0.081 ms at 1K rows and 1.998 → 0.967 ms at 10K rows while point-query throughput stayed neutral/noisy
